ConEx will give you 200,000 credits to purchase any items you wish. You can also buy Mass Expansions, which take space from your cargo section and allocate it to the weapons section. We strongly recommend that you purchase only one of these items, if any. All others items are at your discression, but we again recommend the IFF Decoder, the Density Scanner, the Armaplast, the Escape Pod, the Auto-Eject, and the Afterburner. As done before, please leave ConEx then land again.
